spec.title: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
spec.summary: One-head causal self-attention with parallel Q/K/V inputs, row-wise probability normalization and an independent value path.

spec.layout: Parallel Q and K inputs meet at QK^T. A compact mask side input meets the scale/mask operator. Scores proceed to row-wise softmax; the independent V lane bypasses the score path and joins P only at PV. O is the rightmost sink. Shapes belong to tensors, not decorative badges. Grouping is explanatory, not a hardware containment claim.
annotations: Batch and head dimensions are omitted.
Additive mask precedes softmax; V does not enter score normalization.
assumptions: Single attention head, causal self-attention, no dropout.

description: 画一张用于算法讲解的单头 causal self-attention 数据流图。输入 Q 和 K 的形状都是 N × d_k，V 是 N × d_v，三路输入并行。Q、K 汇入 QK^T 得到 N × N 分数，然后除以 sqrt(d_k) 并加上 causal mask M；M 在允许位置为 0，未来位置为 -inf。逐行 softmax 得到 P，P 与旁路传入的 V 做 PV，输出 O，形状 N × d_v。请让读者看清张量、算子和汇合关系，V 不经过 softmax，不把三路输入串起来。省略 batch、head 维度和 dropout。
